en.clipped: It clipped: lower the gain. Tap to clear.
en.micDenied: Without microphone permission it cannot record. You can allow it in the phone settings.
en.formatHint.WAV24: Lossless, the highest quality. About 17 MB per minute in stereo.
en.formatHint.WAV16: Lossless, CD quality. About 11 MB per minute in stereo.
en.formatHint.AAC: Compressed, nearly indistinguishable from the original. About 2 MB per minute.
en.deviceGone: The chosen microphone is not connected.
en.deleteText: "{name}" is deleted from this phone and cannot be recovered.
en.err.unsupported-format: This phone does not record with that format, sample rate and channels. Try another in Settings.
en.err.mic-unavailable: Could not open the microphone with these settings. Try another combination in Settings.
en.err.mic-busy: Another app is using the microphone.
en.err.device-gone: The chosen microphone is not connected. Pick another in Settings.
en.err.device-refused: The phone does not allow using the chosen microphone.
en.err.read-failed: Reading from the microphone stopped ({detail}). What was recorded up to then is saved.
en.err.wav-full: A WAV reached its maximum size (4 GB). What was recorded is saved; start another recording.
en.err.close-failed: Could not close the file properly. The end of the recording may be damaged.
en.err.io: Could not write the recording ({detail}). Is there space left? What was recorded up to then is saved.
